practice_session_end_check.name: practice_session_end_check
practice_session_end_check.value: ("practice_sessions"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "practice_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL) OR ("practice_sessions"."status" <> 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "practice_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

question_publication_retirement_check.name: question_publication_retirement_check
question_publication_retirement_check.value: ("question_publications"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "question_publications"."retired_by" IS NULL AND "question_publications"."retirement_reason" IS NULL) OR ("question_publications"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "question_publications"."retired_by" IS NOT NULL AND "question_publications"."retirement_reason" IS NOT NULL)

question_version_authorship_check.name: question_version_authorship_check
question_version_authorship_check.value: "question_versions"."generation_run_id" IS NOT NULL OR "question_versions"."author_id" IS NOT NULL
